description: Machine-readable conformance tests. See README.md for the step grammar and the matcher syntax.

tests.title: First acceptance returns a complete receipt
An identical resubmission returns the original receipt
A re-serialized resubmission is the same record
Reusing an identity with different content is a conflict
A record that fails signature verification is never accepted
An unregistered key id is rejected
A key may sign only its authorized event kinds
tests.note: ERR-003 allows a Collector to collapse key-related codes into KEY_UNKNOWN.

tests.title: producer must equal producer_chain.producer_id, after submitter authorization
tests.note: c-pdp may submit for pdp-fleet-2, so step 7 passes and step 10a reports the mismatch. c-fwd may not, so step 7 reports 403 first.

tests.title: A record without the full correlation pair is rejected when it is required
An unlisted profile is rejected
A malformed signature encoding is rejected
A record_id outside the canonical forms is rejected
A duplicate member name rejects the whole request
A missing predecessor is flagged and the record is accepted
A predecessor hash mismatch is flagged and the record is accepted
Two records at one chain position are both kept and flagged
A missing or expired token is rejected with a challenge
A token without the ingestion scope is rejected
A submitter with no evidence-domain binding is rejected
Submitter authorization precedes verification
Evidence domains are isolated
A forwarded record is treated as a direct one
A failed commit leaves nothing visible and is safe to retry
hooks_required: fault injection at the commit point

tests.title: Record size limit is enforced and inclusive
Unsupported media type or content encoding is rejected
An evidence_domain_id in the body plays no part
Concurrent identical submissions yield one acceptance
tests.note: The reference model runs the requests in turn. A real Collector runs them concurrently and must return the same outcome set.

tests.title: A replay survives later key revocation; a new record does not
Every error is a well-formed Problem Details object
tests.note: The runner checks type, title, status, code, retryable, the status and retryable values of the error table, and the absence of tokens and signatures in every error body.

tests.title: Receipt identifiers and timestamp have the required form
A cleartext request is not served
tests.note: The model returns the status 'refused' for any non-TLS request.

tests.title: A record that fails verification is never accepted, even if quarantined
tests.procedure: On a Collector that quarantines, submit V-10. Inspect retrieval, correlation, and the receipt store.
tests.expected: The response is a rejection with no receipt. The record is absent from retrieval and correlation.

tests.title: A Collector killed before the durable commit returns no receipt
hooks_required: process kill at the commit point
tests.procedure: Kill the Collector between receiving V-01 and the durable commit. Restart. Resubmit V-01.
tests.expected: No receipt was returned before the kill. After restart, resubmission is a first acceptance (201, idempotent_replay false).

tests.title: The stored assertion equals the submitted record
An asynchronous Collector omits the four flags and still assesses
An asynchronous Collector never rejects for chain reasons
A non-object single body is a schema failure; broken JSON is malformed
Authorization is evaluated before the body is parsed
Key validity uses the Collector clock, not signed_at
A record delivered after key expiry is rejected, and recovers when validity is extended
valid_from is inclusive and valid_until is exclusive
A replay after expiry keeps the original decision
Client-supplied times are ignored for key validity
A record signed before revocation but first presented after it is rejected
Concurrent submissions with one identity and different content yield one acceptance
Unsupported algorithm is rejected before verification
Quiet limits: nothing is accepted from a record that is too deep
Invalid UTF-8 rejects the request
A record is accepted from a producer with reserved characters in its identifier
A record lacking required members is a schema failure
A JWT access token (client credentials) is accepted as a bearer token
The same client_id at another authorization server is a different submitter
Bindings are per (issuer, client_id)
Producer permission is per (issuer, client_id)
A token from an unlisted issuer is rejected
Key confusion, alg none, symmetric algorithms and header-supplied keys are rejected
The client identifier is not taken from sub
The client identifier claim follows the server's token profile
Headers, body, and certificates do not supply the identity
Expired, not-yet-valid, and wrong-audience tokens are rejected
Introspection: inactive, active, and unavailable
An introspection issuer that differs from the queried server is rejected
A token with an unverifiable cnf is never accepted as a bearer token
tests.note: The fixture Collector supports no sender-constrained mechanism, so even a token with a proof is rejected.

tests.title: Tokens in the query string or body are not accepted
A user token acting through a client yields the client identity
A DPoP-bound token with a verified proof is accepted
Aggregated check: the identity pair is never reduced to client_id
tests.procedure: Inspect the Collector's binding and permission configuration for AS-1 and AS-2 clients that share a client_id.
tests.expected: Bindings and permissions are keyed by the pair, or by an unambiguous encoding of it, and never by client_id alone.

tests.title: M1: unregistered chains are admitted at first sight
M1: a non-genesis first record is admitted and flagged
M2: unregistered chains are rejected, genesis or not
M2: a registered chain is admitted in any arrival order
M2: registering a chain lets the same bytes be accepted
M3: registered chains are pre-registered, others first observed
A record that fails verification creates no chain state
A genesis sentinel on a non-genesis position is flagged in every mode
An admitted chain stays admitted after its registration is removed
Admission does not depend on arrival order
The replay retention period is published and at least one day
A replay is answered until the retention period ends
Replay data lasts as long as the record
After the record is deleted, a resubmission is a new acceptance
After deletion, same identity with different content is accepted
After deletion, current rules apply and nothing is reported as previously accepted
A tightened schema rule does not affect a replay
A withdrawn profile still answers replays
A profile stays replay-only until its records pass retention
tests.procedure: Withdraw the profile of V-01 (replay-only). Check the metadata. Advance the clock past received_at plus idempotency_retention_seconds for every accepted record of that profile.
tests.expected: Until that point the profile is in trace_profiles_replay_only and V-01 is still a replay. Only afterwards may it leave the list.

tests.title: A reduced size limit applies to a resubmission, and the acceptance stands
A replay is answered only to a currently authorized submitter
A changed registration mode does not affect a replay
Replays and new records in one batch
A moved evidence-domain binding evaluates the record in the new domain
Both responses to a replay carry the same snapshot
tests.note: V-01 arrives later and closes the gap, but the replay of V-02 still reports the flags as of its acceptance.

tests.title: Metadata publishes the lookup endpoint and a distinct receipt scope
A lookup returns the stored receipt and nothing else
A replay does not change the stored receipt
An unknown record is not found
A rejected record leaves no receipt
The receipt scope and the ingestion scope are separate
Without receipt-read permission, existing and absent records look the same
A lookup never sees another evidence domain
Authentication and domain errors apply to lookups
A conflicting submission does not change the stored receipt
After deletion the receipt is not found
A producer identifier with reserved characters is addressed by percent-encoding
A 404 is not cacheable; a 200 is at most private
Lookups are rate limited
A lookup does not depend on which submitter sent the record
Per-record outcomes in one batch
Mixed producers are rejected unless supported
An empty batch is rejected
More records than max_batch_records are rejected
A body larger than max_batch_bytes is rejected
Resubmitting a batch returns the original receipts
Within a batch, identity decisions follow array order
In a batch, a conflicting element is rejected after the first is accepted
Arrival before the predecessor is not rejected
An oversized element is rejected alone
A non-object element is rejected alone
A submitter not permitted for the batch's producer gets a request-level 403
A failed commit for one element does not affect the others
hooks_required: fault injection at the commit point

tests.title: A fully valid batch returns 200, never 202 or 207
Results follow request order
A duplicate member in one element rejects the whole request
A truncated body rejects the whole request
A body that is not an array is a batch error
Invalid UTF-8 in one element rejects the whole request
Excessive nesting in one element rejects the whole request
Non-objects do not count toward producer uniformity
Schema and signature failures in a batch are both per element
Mixed-producer batches, when supported, are authorized per element
A Collector without bulk omits the bulk endpoint from its metadata
Metadata contains every required member
issuer equals the Collector's identifier
Bulk members are present when bulk is offered
Only listed profiles are accepted
Authorization server entries state their token profile
Metadata discloses no tenant, client, producer, or key
The registration modes match the behavior for an unregistered chain
tests.note: Run with the G-* tests for the variant that the metadata describes.

tests.title: Each profile entry carries its cryptographic capabilities
Two profiles may list different suites
tests.procedure: Configure a second profile with a different suite. Submit one valid record for each.
tests.expected: Each record is verified only with its own profile's entry. Neither profile's algorithms are used for the other.

tests.title: synchronous_integrity_flags matches the receipts
Retention and replay-only profile lists are consistent
synchronous_integrity_flags false: no receipt carries a flag
The record size limit in the metadata is the limit enforced
Signatures follow the producer's profile
tests.procedure: Verify a producer's output with the public key, using the producer's profile.
tests.expected: The signature verifies as the profile defines; kid is inside the signed scope; the encoding is the profile's.

tests.title: record_id forms and uniqueness
tests.procedure: Generate 10,000 records.
tests.expected: Every record_id is a lowercase UUID or an uppercase ULID, and is unique for the producer.

tests.title: The producer checks the receipt digest
tests.procedure: Compare the producer's own content_digest with the receipt's.
tests.expected: Equal, or the producer reports a mismatch.

tests.title: Retry after a retryable failure
tests.procedure: A stub returns 503 twice, then 201.
tests.expected: The producer resubmits identical bytes with increasing delays and records success only after the 201.

tests.title: Retry-After is honored
tests.procedure: A stub returns 429 with Retry-After: 2.
tests.expected: The producer waits at least 2 seconds.

tests.title: A terminal rejection is not retried
tests.procedure: A stub returns a terminal 400.
tests.expected: The producer does not resubmit unchanged and surfaces the code.

tests.title: A dropped connection is retried with the same bytes
tests.procedure: A stub drops the connection after reading the request.
tests.expected: The producer resubmits the same bytes.

tests.title: Unacknowledged records survive a restart
tests.procedure: Restart the producer with unacknowledged records.
tests.expected: The records are resubmitted from durable storage, or the producer's documentation states that it does not buffer durably.

tests.title: Advertised limits are respected
tests.procedure: Metadata states small limits and no mixed producers.
tests.expected: The producer's requests respect them.

tests.title: A corrected record is a new record
tests.procedure: Fix a rejected record.
tests.expected: The corrected record has a new record_id. Changed content is never resubmitted under the old one.

tests.title: No credentials in records
tests.procedure: Inspect produced records.
tests.expected: No raw bearer tokens or credentials.

tests.title: No invented correlation values
tests.procedure: The producer has no correlation pair for an event while the Collector requires it.
tests.expected: The producer does not submit, or reports the condition. It does not invent values.

tests.title: Reconciliation outcomes are interpreted correctly
tests.procedure: A stub receipt endpoint returns: 200 with the producer's digest; 200 with a different digest; 404 within the retention period; 404 after it; 403.
tests.expected: The producer marks the first accepted and stops retrying; alerts on the second and does not mark it accepted; keeps the record and retries the lookup for the third; infers nothing for the fourth; treats the fifth as an access problem.

tests.title: Content encodings and clients follow the Collector's metadata
tests.procedure: Metadata names a scope, adds an unknown member, and sets a cache lifetime.
tests.expected: The producer reads the scope from metadata, ignores unknown members, and re-reads after the cache lifetime.

tests.title: Producer treats flags correctly
tests.procedure: Receive a receipt without the four flags.
tests.expected: The producer does not treat the absence as no finding.

tests.title: Signed content is preserved
tests.procedure: Pass V-01, V-03, V-04, V-06 through the forwarder.
tests.expected: The canonical form, and therefore the content_digest, of each delivered record equals the source's. V-04 is not altered by re-encoding.

tests.title: Nothing is repaired
tests.procedure: Pass V-10 through the forwarder.
tests.expected: It is delivered unchanged or surfaced, never repaired. The Collector returns SIGNATURE_INVALID.

tests.title: One credential and queue per evidence domain
tests.procedure: Feed records for D1 and D2 through a forwarder with a credential per domain.
tests.expected: Each request uses the matching credential. No request mixes domains.

tests.title: Custody is not acceptance
tests.procedure: The Collector stub delays its response.
tests.expected: Before the receipt the forwarder reports at most custody upstream. After it, acceptance.

tests.title: At-least-once delivery over restarts
tests.procedure: Kill the forwarder after it acknowledged custody, restart; the Collector stub fails twice before accepting.
tests.expected: Every record is delivered, and the Collector shows one receipt per record.

tests.title: Terminal rejections are surfaced
tests.procedure: The Collector returns a terminal 400 for one record.
tests.expected: Not retried. Surfaced with code and record_id. A KEY_NOT_VALID rejection is kept for resubmission.

tests.title: Backoff and Retry-After
tests.procedure: The Collector returns 429 with Retry-After and 503.
tests.expected: Backoff and Retry-After honored.

tests.title: Transport metadata is not evidence
tests.procedure: Set conflicting producer identity and domain in transport metadata.
tests.expected: No effect on the submitted record, the credential used, or the Collector's decisions.

tests.title: Metadata limits and own credential
tests.procedure: Metadata states limits and no mixed producers.
tests.expected: Batches respect them. The forwarder authenticates with its own credential.

tests.title: Consumption position advances only after a disposition
tests.procedure: A broker-backed forwarder; the Collector is unavailable.
tests.expected: The consumer position does not advance. After recovery, delivery completes.

tests.title: No tokens or content in logs
tests.procedure: Inspect forwarder logs.
tests.expected: No tokens, no record content.

tests.title: Receipts are retained for reconciliation
tests.procedure: Pass records through and ask the forwarder what it holds per record.
tests.expected: For each record: producer_id, record_id, content_digest, receipt_id, received_at.

tests.title: Only permitted producers are forwarded
tests.procedure: Offer the forwarder a record from a producer it is not permitted to forward for.
tests.expected: The forwarder does not submit it.

tests.title: No ordering dependence
tests.procedure: Deliver a producer's chain to the forwarder in reverse order.
tests.expected: Delivery completes, in any order.

tests.title: Holding time stays below the replay retention
tests.procedure: Hold records near idempotency_retention_seconds.
tests.expected: The forwarder alerts, and does not treat a later resubmission as a replay.

tests.title: Pre-verification is optional and not authoritative
tests.procedure: Enable pre-verification and feed it a record with a bad signature.
tests.expected: It raises an alarm or discards visibly. It does not repair the record.

tests.title: A Collector that advertises gzip accepts a gzip-encoded body
tests.note: A real harness gzips the body. The model does not decode it.

tests.title: The decoded size limit is enforced while decoding
tests.procedure: Send a gzip body that decodes to more than max_record_bytes (a decompression bomb).
tests.expected: The Collector stops decoding at the limit and returns 413 without allocating the decoded size.

tests.title: A key or algorithm named in the request is never used
An array that exceeds the profile limit is a schema failure, never truncated
Records without correlation context are accepted and marked when the Collector allows it
A record received long after signed_at is accepted and flagged late
The same record_id from another producer is a different identity
Rate limiting returns 429 with Retry-After
An integrity hold refuses submissions with 503
tests.procedure: Put the Collector in its integrity-hold state and submit V-01.
tests.expected: 503 COLLECTOR_INTEGRITY_HOLD, retryable true, Retry-After present, nothing accepted.

tests.title: An unexpected failure returns 500 and accepts nothing
tests.procedure: Cause an unexpected internal failure while processing V-01.
tests.expected: 500 INTERNAL_ERROR, retryable true, no receipt, record, or index entry. A retry of the same bytes is a first acceptance.

tests.title: Trailing content after the JSON value rejects the request
A producer-supplied content_digest member has no effect
Request-form rules apply to a replay
A Collector that cannot process a batch at all responds at request level
An introspection result is not cached beyond the token's lifetime
tests.procedure: Return active:true with a short exp, then active:false for the same token after exp, and resubmit.
tests.expected: The second submission is rejected with 401. The first result was not reused after exp.

tests.title: Clients validate the Collector's certificate
tests.procedure: Present a certificate for another host name, then one from an untrusted chain.
tests.expected: The client refuses both and sends no token.

tests.title: Deduplication beyond the retention period is not assumed
tests.procedure: Hold a record for longer than idempotency_retention_seconds, then resubmit.
tests.expected: The producer does not treat the resubmission as a replay and does not depend on the Collector for deduplication.
